name: Selena FM S.A.
summary: Selena FM S.A., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes construction chemicals and general construction accessories in European Union, Eastern Europe, Asia, North America, and South America. The company offers polyurethane foams, sealants, adhesives, thermal insulation systems, flooring systems, ceramic tile systems, interior wall systems, construction mortars, and waterproofing materials, as well as other products, such as building tapes, wood preservatives, chemical anchors, tools, and accessories under the Tytan, Artelit, Quilosa, TACK-R, Praxa, Cool-R, and Matizol names.
